// diagnostic

E0144

`result` used inside a `#Pre` condition — it only exists once the function has returned (D-PREPOST1)

What

`result` used inside a `#Pre` condition — it only exists once the function has returned (D-PREPOST1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0144

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0144: tests/ui/contract_result_misuse.stderr.

Error [E0144]: `result` isn't available in a `#Pre` condition
  --> tests/ui/contract_result_misuse.jet:1:6
    |
  1 | #Pre(result > 0, "result must be positive") fn add_fee(cents: Int) Int -> { return cents + 5 }
    |      ^^^^^^
 Why: `result` names the return value, which only exists once the function has returned — a `#Pre` condition runs at entry, before there is one
 Fix: use `result` only in a `#Post` condition
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0144
